historical_worker_inputs: accepted original-method facts for each frozen route slot
separately reviewed date-safe selected finterm procedural-card projection
fixed typed output schema and exact verified Sol transport prompt

fintern_integration.origin_label: Finterm MIT editorial procedural framework, retrospective implementation under test; not proof of a native investor algorithm.
fintern_integration.sanitize_rule: Selected procedural instructions must contain no current/post-cutoff company facts, current holdings, case/outcome narrative, target-security winner labels or prior method opinions. Any factual statement about the original method needs accepted original pre-cutoff evidence; otherwise remove it or label a nonfactual independently authored procedural question.
prohibited_worker_material: Full current source key or raw current dossiers/catalogue
Backbone/model findings generated by another view

accepted_adapter_integration.per_view_or_declared_shared_calculation_: State whether deterministic numeric calculations are shared from the immutable facts or computed independently per view; freeze this choice before outcomes.
accepted_adapter_integration.inputs: Only semantically validated admitted historical facts and explicitly authored forecast/discount assumptions frozen before outcome review.
accepted_adapter_integration.source_calculation_execution: A future authorized execution child runs only reviewed code. This assembly has not run it.
accepted_adapter_integration.worker_prior_output_policy: Do not feed one master’s conclusion or scored adapter interpretation to another. Deterministic raw arithmetic may be an explicitly frozen common input projection with exact hashes and identical declared use, without recommendation/quality-score contamination.
accepted_adapter_integration.result_ownership: Each completed research wrapper references exact accepted adapter_result_v1_1 bytes/hash outside the strict R2 object. Missing/inapplicable valuation stays missing/inapplicable.
accepted_adapter_integration.economic_claim_allocation: Total issuer equity must allocate ordinary/preference/other claims before a listing/class denominator. ADR/ordinary ratios and reporting/quote FX are verified dated conversions. No DCF is forced where this bridge cannot be supported.
accepted_adapter_integration.cash_flow_semantics: Require explicit enterprise-FCFF operating-tax/reinvestment/cash-flow bridge and net-interest/lease/other-claim treatment. No silent import of after-interest CFO-capex, issuer FCF, owner earnings or FCFE. Unsupported enterprise cash stays unavailable; assumptions are authored and frozen before outcomes.
accepted_adapter_integration.missing_result_rule: A present integration contract may record blocked_missing_inputs or not_applicable with an honest missing result and missing valuation panels; the supported qualitative branch may continue. Absence of the integration contract or silently omitted R2 accounting blocks generation.

mandatory_preflight_checks: Each selected card projection hash resolves to preserved source and reviewed sanitized fragment
Every method fact and company fact is actually public by cutoff
No post-cutoff information or prior opinions in exact worker bytes
Route has exactly three distinct requested/suitable slots and a genuine challenge, including honest abstentions
All fixed prompt/settings/roles and actual Sol identity verified and archived
Exact R2 request/result schema, units, domain and cross-artifact hashes pass
Ticker-level actual-view/holding check separate from generic method audit
Forecast horizon and numerical assumptions frozen and preserved
fail_closed: Any missing card/R2 integration receipt, invalid hash/ID/date/identity/semantic check blocks opinion generation. Do not silently omit finterm or substitute another numerical engine.
implementation: No transport validator, card projection extractor or numerical engine is implemented/executed in this bundle.

independent_call_contract.model_input: One assigned master/method file, the frozen security facts, that view’s frozen selected backbone cards and fixed single-view output schema; no sibling opinions or reviewer/outcome data.
independent_call_contract.schema_specialization: Freeze the model-facing master_id as const to the assigned route identity and archive the exact specialized schema/prompt hashes.
independent_call_contract.aggregation_order: Validate/enrich each independent one-view response first. Only then assemble exactly three distinct assigned slots and synthesis in the outer research wrapper. No model worker is asked to fill the three-slot wrapper.
canonical_per_view_receipts: Exact card IDs/projection hash and verified source fragments
R2 contract/request/result artifacts and executed/shared/blocked/inapplicable status with reason
